package.name: safety_gate
package.description: Deterministic safety command-gate for the JetAuto AMR. Split into a pure, source-agnostic policy core (omnidirectional obstacle zones + e-stop + worst-case combination) and a thin ROS node (added later) that gates /cmd_vel into /cmd_vel/safety_limited and publishes the safety verdict. This increment ships the policy core and its unit tests only.
